Refocus the design task around a specific clay tectonic: a terracotta baguette rainscreen over a backup wall, with clear dimensions, layering, and assembly logic that the modeling agent must script.

- System + parameters (with ranges): Terracotta baguette rainscreen on horizontal rails over a flat backup wall (no through-voids). Define: floor_height (2.8–3.6 m), bay_width (1.2–1.8 m), total_width/height, depth_total (200–350 mm), depth_backing (100–150 mm), baguette_w (40–80 mm), baguette_d (40–120 mm), baguette_c2c (80–160 mm), vertical_gap (8–12 mm), rail_z_pitch (400–800 mm), edge_margin (120–200 mm), reveal_depth (30–80 mm). Require a continuous backup plane at Y=0 and all clay units extruded along +Y to depth_total; shadow gap at perimeter (15–20 mm).
- Step-by-step facade composition: (1) Subdivide width into equal bays by bay_width; subdivide height by floor_height (express floor-to-floor). (2) Create backup wall (XZ rectangle) and extrude to depth_backing. (3) For each floor and bay, place horizontal rail curves at z = base+rail_z_pitch increments; array vertical hollow baguettes (section rectangle baguette_w×baguette_d) from z=plinth_top to z=floor_slab_bottom−30 mm; clamp count = floor((bay_clear−2×edge_margin+vertical_gap)/(baguette_w+vertical_gap)). (4) Define window bands per floor (e.g., sill_z=0.9–1.1 m, head_z=2.0–2.2 m): within those bands, remove baguettes or increase baguette_c2c to target a 0.35–0.65 solid-to-void; add framed reveals (reveal_depth) and spandrel tiles (t=30 mm) above/below. (5) Add a 600 mm plinth zone with solid ribbed terracotta tiles and a 150–250 mm top cornice by increasing baguette_d by 20–40 mm in the top strip.
- Constraints that cue clay materiality: Enforce joints/gaps (8–12 mm) visibly between units; stop baguettes 30 mm short of bay edges for a shadow gap; insert a 15 mm vertical expansion joint every 6–8 m (after N bays). Prevent full-depth perforations (backing wall always present); cap baguette ends with 3–5 mm chamfers/fillets. Validate ranges: baguette_c2c ≥ baguette_w+8; window widths ≥ 0.6 m and heights 0.9–1.4 m; rail_z_pitch divides floor_height with ≤200 mm remainder.

- Lock the facade to a concrete-specific system and dimensions: precast ribbed panelization with base panel = 1.2 m (X) × 3.6 m (Z) × 150 mm (Y depth). Joints = 20 mm; edge chamfer = 10 mm; reveals = 40 mm deep at 300 mm c/c; optional tie-holes = Ø25–50 mm on a 600 × 600 mm grid; spandrel bands at each floor thickened to 200–250 mm. Provide ranges: panel width 0.9–1.5 m, thickness 120–200 mm, reveal depth 15–50 mm, joint 10–25 mm, tie-hole spacing 450–900 mm.
- Replace randomness with constructible rules: subdivide X by panel width and Z by floor-to-floor (e.g., 3.6 m). Openings must be whole-panel multiples with min pier = 0.6 m; reserve a ground-level entry bay of 2–3 panels; enforce perimeter frame (≥0.6 m returns) and continuous load paths (no isolated pixels; lintels/spandrels continuous across openings). Define vertical pilasters every 2.4–3.6 m and window bays as panel count patterns per floor.
- Write step-by-step modeling instructions tied to axes (X horizontal, Z vertical, Y depth): 1) Generate facade boundary and grid by panel width × floor height; 2) Create base panel Breps, place 20 mm joints; 3) Boolean reveals and tie-holes; 4) Apply 10 mm edge chamfers; 5) Add spandrels/pilasters by thickening designated rows/columns; 6) Cut openings only by removing full panels, then trim with continuous lintel/spandrel geometry. Expose all listed parameters for control.

Adopt a metal cassette rainscreen system and encode metal-specific dimensions/constraints: modules 0.6–1.2 m (w) x 0.9–1.8 m (h); 12–18 mm vertical/horizontal reveals; 20–40 mm hemmed returns with 3 mm bend radius; cassette depths 40/60/90 mm; subframe rails (Z) at 600 mm c/c with 30 mm-wide vertical T/L profiles; window bays set within modules with 80–120 mm shadow-box depth.

Translate into explicit, stepwise geometry for the modeling agent: on XZ, lay out an overall facade frame and a panel grid (x_count≥5, y_count≥4). For each module: draw outer rectangle, offset in by (reveal + return), create face; extrude face to cassette depth, model returns as perimeter offset strip extruded back; fillet outer edges to 3 mm; leave 12–18 mm gaps as reveals. Place subframe rails behind reveals as continuous vertical members. In selected modules (e.g., 40–60%), cut a centered opening sized 0.5–0.75 of module (w,h) and set back its inner “shadow” reveal by 80–120 mm.

Constrain variability to read as a facade: keep reveals constant across the field; vary cassette depth by row or bay (not per-cell noise); align openings in horizontal bands to imply floors; enforce minimum proportions so frames remain legible (return_depth ≥ 0.02 m; reveal ≥ 0.012 m; frame rim ≥ 0.06 m). Optionally designate zones for perforation fields (hole Ø 10–30 mm on 30–60 mm staggered pitch) limited to spandrel modules only, avoiding window modules.

- Remap axes and global dimensions (facadeness fix): Build on XZ (Z = vertical). Add facade_width, facade_height, base_elevation, facade_depth. Replace the current use of panel_height along Y with Z-based story/unit heights. Keep Y strictly as depth: stone_thickness (0.06–0.10 m cladding; 0.15–0.30 m masonry). Ensure base_elevation ≥ 0 and no geometry dips below ground.
- Replace thin NURBS panels with discrete stone courses (material logic): Introduce unit_w = 0.30–0.60 m, unit_h = 0.15–0.30 m, joint_w = 0.005–0.012 m. Generate running-bond courses (1/2 overlap), compute cols/rows from facade_width/height and unit sizes, create box solids per block (extrude along Y by stone_thickness), and model joints as gaps. Optional arris_chamfer = 0.003–0.008 m and rustication_depth = 0.005–0.025 m applied on block faces.
- Convert sinusoidal “wave” to corbelled/faceted relief in Y (stone-safe): Keep wave_amplitude as total target projection (max_out = 0.06–0.12 m) and wave_frequency as number of bays across width. For each column i, set target y_offset(i) = clamp(amplitude * sin(2π * i / period), ±max_out); for each course k, increment toward target with per-course corbel_step_max = 0.010–0.020 m to avoid bending. Cap offsets, add a continuous plinth course at base and a coping/top course to terminate relief cleanly.
